text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Shundai Festival drawing 
near, we came to watch yabusame practice 
at Tokai Teio's request.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Gentle breeze, harmonious warmth... with 
this, I can— —kh!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Waaahhhhh...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that!? Dead center again!! 
Amazing, amazing! You haven't missed a 
single one~!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Preeeez! That was so, so cool just now--!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Thank you, Teio. If I was able to 
set a good example as your predecessor, 
then facing this with all my heart was 
well worth it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...! Me too! I wanna do it too! Just like 
the President!! Come on, please?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! They might have different purposes, 
but they're both Shundai Festival outfits! 
You gotta dress the part with stuff like 
this, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Prez! Are there any tips to 
shooting a bow coolly like you just did!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... It's not quite a "trick," but 
rather imbuing each arrow I loose with my 
feelings, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Feelings, huh... Okay. Anyway, I'll give 
it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ......Take this!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Dead center!! Ain't nothin' for 
someone as great as me—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait, something feels off~. Like, it's not 
super cool... not like the Preznident...
choice_data_list: Did you try putting your feelings into it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You mean the trick Prez mentioned? Of 
course! I'll put it right on—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe not... But what kind of feelings... 
am I supposed to put into it?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Something like the feelings poured 
into our Racewear?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Is this what it means?! My ideal! No 
matter what contest it is, I shall emerge 
victorious! For *I* am the invincible—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no, that's not it. This is about my 
passion for the race~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll channel my 'never give up' 
spirit... like this, maybe?! A blazing hot 
feeling!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
“...... But Prez, didn't you seem pretty 
cool when you shot it?”

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, I don't get it at all! I mean, what 
kind of feelings did the Prez put into it 
in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Looking at Prez's bow... what did I... 
feel?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
......It looked so cool, and I thought I 
wanted to try it too――

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Was that what Prez wanted to tell me? That 
I should try taking part in traditional 
events too...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I see! This is an event for the Shundai 
Festival... A tradition handed down 
through generations of Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Then the feelings I must carry are—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's my resolve to carry on Prez's 
feelings!
choice_data_list:
(!? She seems different from just a moment 
ago?)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Reach themmm...—!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Brilliantly done, Teio. You showed me a 
truly splendid counterattack.
choice_data_list:
That was amazing! You looked like a 
completely different person!

That was amazing! You looked like a 
completely different person!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks Trainer! Now I can enter a 
Yabusame match anytime!
choice_data_list: As long as you don't forget this feeling.
As long as you don't forget this feeling.
Maybe I'll incorporate this into training.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks Trainer! Now I can enter a 
Yabusame match anytime!
choice_data_list: As long as you don't forget this feeling.
As long as you don't forget this feeling.
Maybe I'll incorporate this into training.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"That part's already totally flawless! 
Just watch!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! What do you think, Prez?♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Whether your retaliatory arrow was good or 
bad is not for me to judge, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Gah!? ...You're totally right! I gotta try 
even harder too♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, huh!? Did it slip out of place a 
bit!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Succeeding once doesn't necessarily mean 
it will go well next time. At any rate, 
it's all about repetition."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio learned that getting better at 
anything requires time and effort.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, seriously!? Why is it flying over 
thereee!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Even if you succeed once, continue honing 
your skills without becoming complacent. 
That is the surefire path to growth."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through both success and failure, Tokai 
Teio had gained even more valuable 
lessons.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! That way, I feel like I can 
get even closer to the President!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Watch me, Trainer! I'm gonna become an 
even cooler Lord Teio!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing her reassuring words made me look 
forward to seeing her future growth.
